shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'cat app/page.tsx && cat app/catalog/page.tsx && cat lib/data.ts && cat app/layout.tsx'
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- app/page.tsx lib/data.ts next.config.ts && git status --short'

/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- tsconfig.json && git status --short && rg -n "RSC|Next-Router-Prefetch|next-router-prefetch|next-url|Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/instant-navigation.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/optimizing-prefetching.md | head -80'
/bin/bash -lc "which chromium || which chromium-browser || which google-chrome || true; rg --files node_modules | rg '/(playwright|puppeteer)/' | head -25"

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module -e 'for (const category of [\"featured\", \"sale\"]) { const url = "'`http://localhost:3000/catalog?category=${category}`; const response = await fetch(url, { headers: { rsc: "1", "next-router-prefetch": "2", "next-router-state-tree": JSON.stringify(["", { children: ["__PAGE__", {}] }, null, null, true]) } }); const body = await response.text(); console.log(JSON.stringify({category, status:response.status, contentType:response.headers.get("content-type"), length:body.length, featuredHeading:body.includes("Featured products"), saleHeading:body.includes("Products on sale"), deskLamp:body.includes("Desk Lamp"), canvasTote:body.includes("Canvas Tote"), loading:body.includes("Loading category...")})); }'"'"

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module -e 'for (const category of [\"featured\", \"sale\"]) { for (const mode of [\"segment\", \"runtime\"]) { const headers = mode === \"segment\" ? {rsc:\"1\", \"next-router-prefetch\":\"1\", \"next-router-segment-prefetch\":\"/_tree\"} : {rsc:\"1\", \"next-router-prefetch\":\"2\"}; const response = await fetch("'`http://localhost:3000/catalog?category=${category}`, { headers }); const body = await response.text(); console.log(JSON.stringify({category, mode, status:response.status, type:response.headers.get("content-type"), length:body.length, featuredHeading:body.includes("Featured products"), saleHeading:body.includes("Products on sale"), deskLamp:body.includes("Desk Lamp"), canvasTote:body.includes("Canvas Tote"), loading:body.includes("Loading category...")})); } }'"'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '115,145p' node_modules/next/dist/client/flight-data-helpers.js && rg -n \"parseAndValidateFlightRouterState|router state header was sent\" node_modules/next/dist/server -g '*.js' -g '"'!*.map'"' | head -20"

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module -e 'for (const category of [\"featured\", \"sale\"]) { const headers={rsc:\"1\",\"next-router-prefetch\":\"2\",\"next-router-state-tree\":encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify([\"\",{children:[\"__PAGE__\",{}]}]))}; const response=await fetch("'`http://localhost:3000/catalog?category=${category}`,{headers}); const body=await response.text(); console.log(JSON.stringify({category,status:response.status,type:response.headers.get("content-type"),length:body.length,featuredHeading:body.includes("Featured products"),saleHeading:body.includes("Products on sale"),deskLamp:body.includes("Desk Lamp"),canvasTote:body.includes("Canvas Tote"),loading:body.includes("Loading category...")})); }'"'"
/bin/bash -lc "node -e 'const fs = require(\"node:fs\"); fs.rmSync(\".next\", { recursive: true }); fs.unlinkSync(\"next-env.d.ts\")'"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && git status --short && git diff -- app/page.tsx lib/data.ts next.config.ts tsconfig.json'
